title: Valmet SpatialSense Approved 3D Equipment & Internal Component Catalog

mechanical_seal.label: Mechanical Seal Assembly (Shaft Housing Exit)
mechanical_seal.description: Primary shaft sealing interface where the rotating pump shaft exits the stationary bearing housing and back cover into the wet volute chamber.

impeller.label: Closed Centrifugal Impeller (Hub, Shroud & 6 Vanes)
impeller.description: 6-vane radial centrifugal impeller keyed to the shaft nose; transfers kinetic energy to the boiler feedwater.

shaft_coupling.label: Pump Shaft & Flexible Drive Coupling
shaft_coupling.description: Precision stainless steel rotor shaft transmitting torque from the electric drive motor through the flexible coupling.

bearings.label: Inboard/Outboard Bearings & Bearing Housing
bearings.description: Dual rolling-element bearings supporting radial hydraulic loads and axial rotor thrust inside the cast iron bearing frame.

volute_casing.label: Volute Casing, Nozzles, Wear Ring & Joint Bolts
volute_casing.description: Pressure-retaining spiral volute casing that converts impeller velocity head into static discharge pressure on the feedwater header.

motor_frame.label: TEFC Drive Motor, Baseplate & Mounting Bolts
motor_frame.description: Induction drive motor and heavy structural steel skid baseplate.

mechanical_seal_leak.label: Mechanical seal leak
mechanical_seal_leak.summary: Thermal distortion and abrasive wear across the SiC rotating ring and stationary seal seat allow pressurized boiler feedwater to weep past the seal gland where the shaft exits the housing.

impeller_cavitation.label: Impeller eye cavitation
impeller_cavitation.summary: Low suction head (NPSHa < NPSHr) causes vapor bubble collapse along the leading edges of Impeller blades 1–6 and the front wear ring.

bearing_overheat.label: Outboard bearing wear & overheat
bearing_overheat.summary: Elevated axial thrust and lubrication breakdown increase friction in Bearing (outboard) and Bearing (inboard).
